thm:OQED-subtracted-zero-depth.scope: Actual common subtraction equals its nonnegative difference-square integral at positive depth. Uniform subtraction bound, zero-depth logarithmic limit/slope and unsubtracted finite part remain.

cor:OQED-aposteriori-Schur.scope: Actual Neumann inverse, ordered resolvent/Schur/rate constants, positive-rate certificate and holomorphic inverse/Schur families are proved for bounded Banach operator spaces. Graph-domain generalization and identification with the physical baseline pole remain.

prop:OS-counterexample.scope: Literal complex heat Fourier covariance equals its real cosine representation and has a non-PSD positive-time two-point Hankel matrix at every sufficiently small spacing.
